what: The status of the thirteen protocol requirements as this tree holds them. A session that closes or moves an item edits its row and its report (protocol-13/, beside this file) in the same commit as the work, and publish_protocol13.py writes the public folder Audit/Protocol-13 from that commit: the reports, the table from this file and the source; an item is closed only with an implementation revision, the exact test command and its result in the report of that item.

items.requirement: A complete window proof and verifier
items.summary: Closed on 2026-10-25. The relation of a window and its verifier are implemented (WINDOW-RELATION.md); the closure of a window is stated as theorems with proofs (WINDOW-THEOREM.md), Lemmas 1-2 and Theorems 1-4 checked by machine in Lean (formal/Window.lean: exit 0, no sorry); the obligations O-1 to O-6 are discharged; agreement on what a window decided (AGREEMENT.md, section 6) is implemented and held by the test of four machines. The ring of the core is green on 4451b21 and the run of O-6 on 033c6b7 (01-WINDOW-PROOF.md, Runs). Outside this closure: the rule that bounds the memory of a stalled window, and the run on six hosts (item 13); model checking of the code with Kani is item 2.

items.requirement: Close only a verified canonical Proposal
items.summary: A participant count may trigger an attempt, but must not advance the closed head or authorize issuance. Recompute the beacon and archive the verified Proposal and its actual identifier.
Bind the window, recipient, amount and one-time redemption. Reject excess value, invented rights and repeated redemption at the verifying node.

items.requirement: Bind admission witnesses to one state
items.summary: The identity record, machine key, operator secret and public values must share an authenticated origin. Reject mixed witnesses.

items.requirement: Prove continuity and return after a partition
items.summary: Enforce bitmap shift, period boundaries and required participation inside admission. Replaying other machines' records does not create one's own participation.

items.requirement: Remove clock authority and implicit private bootstrap
items.summary: The same protocol state must have the same validity under changed clocks or machine speed in both generations. Test settings must not silently become network settings.

items.requirement: Make the earlier core's lottery deterministic
items.summary: Use historical thresholds and weights, correct epoch boundaries and complete reveals; reject conflicting proposals and unannounced private bootstrap.

items.requirement: Apply and persist the entire window atomically
items.summary: Tables, proof, Proposal archive and head must recover together after rejection, crash or replay, without extra issuance. Partial storage repairs do not establish this transaction.

items.requirement: Authenticate first connection and fast sync
items.summary: A fresh node must authenticate history from the network's trusted beginning or an authenticated checkpoint. A server's own advertised root does not authenticate its snapshot.
Distinguish insufficient quorum, missing data, invalid proof and unavailable diagnostics through the used network path. Timeouts must not authorize a close.

Verify handshake identities, protected entry points, direct origin access, DNS, logs, public history, resource limits and replays. Total anonymity is a design requirement, not a verified property of this snapshot.

items.requirement: Reconcile code, specification, audits and publication
items.summary: Each closed finding needs an implementation revision and matching evidence. Changed proof identifiers require an explicit migration. Whole-repository consistency and historical disclosures remain under review.

Multiple weighted nodes must close, lose quorum, recover, partition, rejoin and restart with canonical artifacts. The authorized self-run on a separate server must preserve canonical artifacts; it is not independent external review.
